description: Generate a page of procedural asemic writing — random-but-writing-like glyph strokes that flow left-to-right along stacked baselines but spell nothing. A Script SOP lays out `rows` × `glyphs` cells; each glyph is a short chain of `strokes` control points walking a noise-perturbed pen, with italic `slant`, per-stroke `jitter`, and occasional pen-lifts (`lift_chance`) that break marks apart. The polylines are thickened into tube ink strokes and rendered with an orthographic camera as calligraphic line art on a coloured page. Deterministic per `seed`. Genuinely distinct from create_growth_system (L-system branches) and create_vector_lines (image-traced contours). Creates a new baseCOMP under `parent_path`. Exposes Jitter, Slant, Thickness, and Seed controls. Returns a summary plus a JSON block with the container path, created node paths, output path, exposed controls, node errors, warnings, and an inline preview image.

glyphs.description: Glyphs per row, laid left to right along the baseline.

jitter.description: How far the pen wanders vertically per stroke (fraction of the line height). 0 = flat dashes, 1 = wild scrawl.

lift_chance.description: Probability the pen lifts (breaks the polyline) between adjacent strokes, giving disconnected marks.

parent_path.description: Parent network where the asemic-writing container is created (default '/project1').

rows.description: Number of baselines (lines of writing) stacked top to bottom.

seed.description: RNG seed — same seed reproduces the same page of writing.

slant.description: Italic slant applied to every glyph (x-shear per unit height). 0 = upright.

strokes.description: Control points per glyph — more strokes = more elaborate, script-like marks.

thickness.description: Tube SOP radius for the rendered ink strokes.

name: create_asemic_writing
title: Create asemic writing
